description: Main application component for a news aggregator frontend, handling UI rendering, state management, data fetching, and user interactions.

methods.name: performFetch
methods.description: Fetches news data based on current mode and state, updating articles and results count.

methods.name: onSelectCategory
methods.description: Handles category selection, resets mode to headlines and page to 1.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Triggers search mode with the provided query, resets page to 1.

methods.name: onShowBookmarks
methods.description: Switches mode to display bookmarked articles.

methods.name: onBookmark
methods.description: Toggles bookmark status for an article and refreshes data as needed.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of results if available.

methods.name: prevPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page if not on the first page.
